desc.en: It is highly recommended to perform Thanksgiving Prostration after the obligatory namaz. Too many are the duas and zikrs that may be said during the Thanksgiving Prostration. In this connection, Imam Ali ibn Musa ar-Reza (a) is reported to have said that one may repeat 100 times one of the following words during the Thanksgiving Prostrations…
desc.rurdu: Imam Reza (a.s) se waarid hai keh har ek zikr ko 100 martaba Sajdah-e-Shukr me padhe…
desc.urdu: امام علی رضا ؑفرماتے ہیں : سجدۂ شکر میں چاہیں تو سومرتبہ شُکْرًا شُکْرًا یا سومرتبہ کہیں۔۔۔

desc.en: Imam Reza (a) is also reported to have said: to repeat 3 times while in Sajdah…
desc.rurdu: Imam Reza (a) se yeh bhi waarid hai ke is zikr ko 3 martaba Sajdeh mein padhe…
desc.urdu: حضرتؑ سے یہ بھی منقول ہے کہ سجدۂ شکر میں کم سے کم تین مرتبہ کہیں۔۔۔

desc.en: Recite Thanking Allah in Prostration <Yaa Rabbe Wa A’z-tanee Fa-lam>.
desc.rurdu: Sajdah-e-Shukr ki dua <Yaa Rabbe Wa A’z-tanee Fa-lam> padhe.
desc.urdu: سجدۂ شکر کی دعا <یَا رَبِّ وَعَظْتَنِیْ فَلَمْ>۔ پڑھے۔

desc.en: Recite Thanking Allah in Prostration <Yaa Man Laa Yazeedo-hu il-haaho>.
desc.rurdu: Sajdah-e-Shukr ki dua <Yaa Man Laa Yazeedo-hu il-haaho> padhe.
desc.urdu: سجدۂ شکر کی دعا <یَا مَنْ لَّا یَزِیْدُهٗ اِلْحَاحُ> پڑھے۔
